scope: Finite prefix of the OpenAI diagonal cutoff schedule, computed from caller-supplied rational upper bounds. Exact arithmetic verifies the schedule inequalities but does not certify the input bounds or h_lower.

assumptions.true_h_requirement: h >= h_lower; must be certified independently
assumptions.coefficient_bounds: each supplied C[j,m] is a certified positive upper bound for the compact template jet norm, for all active scales c in [0,1] and inner points in K
assumptions.bound_provenance: SYNTHETIC TEST INPUT ONLY. These values are not extracted or certified bounds for the OpenAI construction.

verified_contract.stage_inequality: C[j,m] * (1/a_j)^(h_lower*j) <= 2^(-j); hence the source absorption inequality holds for every q <= 1/a_j when h >= h_lower
verified_contract.terminal_cutoff: q_min*a_N > 1, so every stage j >= N is zero for every q >= q_min

limitations: No compact derivative upper bounds for the selected OpenAI coefficients are currently extracted in this repository.
The noncomputable selected coefficient functions and their compact jet maxima are not supplied by this tool.
This creates a finite schedule only on q >= q_min; it does not provide a single finite approximation through q=0 or prove a Navier-Stokes numerical reproduction.
